Hello.

Would you like to add elite soldiers to your Gazmask company?

Do you agree with me that the Cadians aren't the only ones who deserve to have their precious little Kasrkins? After all, didn't those losers lose their home planet? And didn't the gazmask boys had rather atomised their own planet than leave it to the enemy? I say THEY deserve better body armour and better guns!

So here they are, the Panzer-grenadiers. I hope you like them!

This free sample contained those two models:

- 1 Watchmaster with an hellpistol and a powersword.
- 1 heavy gunners with an heavy stubber.

This cephalopod inspired robot is a ghoulish spektor that haunts archeotech ruins.

It is a remix of Akewea's Sci-Fi Sphere Drone (https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:5266420) and Franklima260's Mini Servo Arm (https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/sci-fi-sphere-drone)

The arms are fully posable with ball & socket joints at the shoulder, elbow, and wrist.

Since the attachment point to the base is pretty small, I've included 4 additional versions of the tentacles with a rod cutout for pinning of the following sizes
- 1mm brass rod (1.1mm hole)
- 1.5mm brass rod (1.6mm hole)
- 0.8mm thin paperclip (0.9mm hole)
- 1.15mm thick paperclip (1.25mm hole)

The Indebted are the main workforce on the 400 moons. Some of them take up arms, either to rebel against their Void Baron overlords, or in their service.

Designed for 6mm/8mm gaming in mind. Compatible with games such as Adeptus Titanicus or Battletech.

You'll save 40% when buying these as a bundle rather than separately.

This package contains the four existing kits:
1) [Armed Indebted (rifles)](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/smallscale-rifle-armed-worker-gang)
2) [Armed Indebted (close combat)](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/smallscale-close-combat-brutes)
3) [Armed Indebted (pistols)](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/smallscale-gunslingers)
4) [Armed Indebted (flamethrowers)](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/smallscale-flame-troopers)
5) [25mm round bases](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/25mm-round-bases-for-6mm-8mm-miniatures-tech-shanty-texture) (extra inserted bits not included)

All armed gangers are either on 5.8mm round inserts or without such inserts. Note that the 25mm bases are just the bases, not the insert detail bits from the separate kit.

Please do not share or sell these files (including prints and remixes) without my written permission.

"Suported Dwarf The Second by Dopaminis" by Leighbar: https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:4424041

While looking for a Troll Slayer to use in Warhammer Quest I found this great Demon Slayer model, which Leighbar has rescaled and supported. Unfortunately the original seems have disapeared along with its creator. I have used meshmixer to remove the supports to restore the original version so you can support it yourself and rescale it freely.

Leigabar notes their version was "scaled down by +/- 8% so he would be on par with WizKids Nolzur's and DeepCuts minis."
I have kept it at that scale so if you want the original size you'll need to scale it back up to ~108.7%.

This is the second Scummer I've remixed. He makes a great random NPC or supporting character for your role-playing games or miniature games. Don't get me wrong, he could be your character and an epic hero at that. Though he was made to be a bit generic featuring: a rifle/carbine, light armor, and a knife. Scummer #2 here also has a bionic eye and a bionic leg, which can be treated as just cosmetic details. Unless of course, you want them to do more in your games.

Just for an extra bit of fun and functionality, I have included a small random name generator for your scummers in the images above. You know the drill, roll D66 on each of the name tables and then use that to come up with a suitable name. Of course, these tables and the names on them are all just for inspiration. Feel free to pick the names you want, to add your own names to the mix, or change the names in any way that you want. This name generator is a tool, not a box.

You play role-playing games or maybe miniature games (the fun ones with the narrative as central), maybe you play both or some hybrid of the two. So you must find yourself occasionally needing some good guys or bad guys to add to the mayhem. Maybe they are unscrupulous gunmen sent by a local crime boss. Maybe they are stalwart citizens ready to defend their town/neighborhood. Maybe they are the latest member of your space faring crew of adventurers, though you just haven't gotten to know them yet. Maybe they are just hired muscle with guns that your gang hired for a bit of extra firepower in the upcoming battle. Maybe they are just random survivors of the Zombie Apocalypse who could be potential friends or foes. The possibilities are endless for a basic miniature with a firearm (call it a rifle, carbine, or lasgun in this case), some light 'flak' armor, and a combat knife. These NPCs might not be the heroes of the day, but they can't be completely ignored either.

"Every battlefield the Hostile Environment Troops find themselves on, is a hostile, bombarded and chemically saturated one. Taking trenches, cities and sectors require troops in the thousands, and waiting for weeks or months on end for the right moment to strike. To that end, Command uses Shock Assault Troops, Specialists in lightning warfare.

Other armies decorate these soldiers in honors, having them as elite regiments on their planets. The best of the best.
Not so for the Hostile Environment Troops, for in the hellish condition they find themselves in, a simple hole in their suits means they are living on borrowed time.
Most, but not all, Shock Assault are penal legionaires, promised freedom if they survive a single attack on an enemy position. Very few survive to see reinforcements, fewer still survive long enough for a commissar to excuse them of their sins and turn them free men and women.

The life of a Shock Assault Trooper is a short and deadly life, but their sacrifices turn the tide of battle, saving thousands.

Enlist Today!"

This kit is a conversion kit for the newest plastic cadians. The torsos fit the equivelant piece in the assembling book in the plastic box.

there are
7 different heads
11 different torsos

All heads can be given female proportions by decreasing their width by roughly 8%

Using the fantastic model made by FELIXTHECRAZY (along another Ridgerunner proxy that dissapeared time ago and i dont know who made it), i designed this vehicle mostly for my Squat miners, but i think is suitable for Genestealers Cults too.

I cant assure if is a proper Ridgerunner proxy, because i think this model is smaller, but i added all the weapons and accesories listed in GSC army book for the vehicle in case that someone want to use it in that way. Maybe re-escaling it a bit is enough, but i dont how much, i have never seen a real Ridgerunner model before.

The original model is a single piece, meant to be printed in resin, but my experience printing vehicles in resin is not the best, so i prefer print them on PLA. With that in mind, i separated some pieces of the model to make it suitable for FDM printers, specially small parts that will probably break when you try to remove supports, then the best is print them apart and glue them after. Refer the pics to look where each piece goes

Weapons and accesories are small and detailed, and were designed to be printed in resin. You can try to print them in FDM of course, but they will lost a lot of detail, specially with the mining laser.

About the Spotter, i choose a more "technological" option instead a guy with binoculars. It makes more sense i think, and it saved me a lot of work :P

I included the center hull as one piece and in halves. I printed it as one piece, but I think it's easier and faster to print two pieces. Your choice.

I dont discard make some aditional weapons and accesories in the future.

Here are twelve, perhaps crude, though definitely brutal close combat hand-to-hand melee assault weapons. They are intended to allow give you some extra options and conversion bits for your Chaos Cultists. You do love Chaos Cultists don't you?? Though I think they are generic enough to work for most human sized miniatures in any grim and dark dystopian future setting from undercity gangs, to wasteland scavengers, rebels, organized criminal thugs, and pretty much any kind of poorly equipped ne'er-do-wells up to no good.

Here are the 12 unique weapons:

-- Axe
-- Club
-- Hammer1
-- Hammer2
-- Knife1
-- Knife2
-- Mace
-- Pick
-- Pipe
-- Scimitar
-- Sword1
-- Sword2

Each weapon comes in three STL variants:
1) weapon by itself
2) weapon held in a right hand
3) weapon held in a right hand (hand has a nub to socket into wrists)

Knife1 and Knife2 have four variants each, two with the blade held normally and two with the blade held ready to stab. You can mirror the weapons with hands on them to create left-handed versions. All total that comes to 68 different options. You can use these files for physical or digital conversions as you see fit. They are also Creative Common Licensed so that you can modify them as you please and then share your own innovations.

Enjoy, and may the Dark Gods favor you.

This revised version of my old Autopistol STL has some subtle changes that I like. I also added a few variants with different hands attached for easy conversions. In a grimdark science fantasy universe such a weapon as this might be found in the hands of chaotic cultists, undercity gang members, Imperial officials, militia troopers, organized criminals, xeno cultists, merchants and their guards, household troops, and many more. For physically converting or digitally remixing miniatures this one pistol has many potential uses.

I made some changes to my existing Autopistol Model 302 STL. I took most of my inspiration for the original design from a couple images I found online. I liked the look overall, though I felt like the end of the barrel was maybe inclined to break off if dropped. So for this version I changed the proportions so that the muzzle break in front of the weapon connected very slightly to the angled front of the forward handgrip on the pistol. Looking at other images online, I also decided to shorten the pistol's ammo magazine. Previously the magazine extended below the pistol grip, but now it stops just short of being equal in length to the pistol grip. The width and height of the pistol remain the same, but I shortened the overall length from 12mm to 11.5mm which I think makes it scaled a bit better for most plastic, resin, and STL miniatures out there.

Here's a link to the original version.

When servants of the Inquistion must hunt heretics in the dangerous depths of the undercity it never hurts to have some extra firepower. That's were the Servile Cyborg with Sizable Gun comes in. This single-minded automaton can pack as much firepower as a crew served heavy weapon team. He never complains, but he rarely takes any initiative either. In fact, he performs best with a bit of guidance from his friends. He can be equipped with a selection of three devastating heavy weapons depending on your needs. The ODV Heavy Blaster launches bursts of high caliber dual-mode projectiles that are equally effective against armored or unarmored targets. One shot from this weapon is more than enough to deal with a measely chaotic cultist. The opposite end of the spectrum is the mighty Multi-Mazer Melta-Beamer. This weapon hits just one target, but it hits extremely hard! Definitely a waste when targeting a wimpy chaotic cultist, but hulking mutant abominations or vile places of worship for the followers are the Dark Gods are ideal targets. The final weapon option is the Phased Plasma Projector, this weapon is the happy medium of overkill. It hits like a cargo-8 and covers an area wide enough to catch multiple targets. As an additional benefit this particular Servile Cyborg's Sizable Guns each have unique enhancements to improve their reliability. Because let's face it, there is never a techno-guru around when you need one, let alone when you are in the heart of darkness battling heretics.

"El TOPO" is a miniature for the world of INFINITY (the game) that dates back to 2007, when Corvus Belli's Infinity was still young, there were no 3D printing (not even for production masters) and the forums were starting to be active with just a bunch of guys in the spanish community.

Chaos Cultist #11 Heavy Specialist with BIG Stubber

Recently I released "Chaos Cultist #1" and now I'm releasing this big burly brute with a big gun. And you ask, "What happened to Chaos Cultists #2 through #10?" Well, I skipped them for now. I wanted to make a standout cultist that had a bit more gravitas then just a bunch more basic cultists. I do plan to release Chaos Cultists #2 through #10 and more, just no promises on what order they arrive in.

[UPDATE 2023-06-19] I wanted to fine tune a few things on this miniature. I increased the size of the Big Stubber's barrel because it looked to thin and wimpy on the tabletop to me. I raised the height of the two wrenches on the miniature's backpack so that they have more support and should be more sturdy. I've printed them fine before, but if I'm in a hurry when removing the supports I have also torn off the ends. I also added a bit of thickness to the ammo belt that hangs from the Big Stubber (it's on the backside and not noticeable, paint it like the links in the ammo belt). I've printed models with much thinner parts including ammo belts, but I would like to make my designs as robust and hassle free as possible. Enjoy.

It is the dreaded year 1998. For more than a seven years the mighty Union lies in ruins, and God-Pakhan of Thief People sits immobile on his Shkonka Throne of Great Matrosskay Tishina. He is the Boss of Pacankind by the will of the polozhnyak, master of countless maximum security penal colonies from Kaliningrad to Magadan. To carry his will, to make all of CIS bow to his demand and will, God-Pakhan uplifted his most trusted, ruthless and capable pacans to Gopniks. Armed with priced relics from Dark Age of Technology (or "10 years ago"), clad in Strong Armor made from best salvage stolen from long abandoned military installatons that survived being stolen again, they march for war. No corner shop, no shawerma stall, no beer joint is safe, soon to be mugged and... re-roofed.

This is my entry for the next [28mag challenge](https://28-mag.com/2021/01/12/the-28magchallenge-for-2021/).

Beltanya Zukhal is a legal clerc of the Administratum whose task is to record anything and everything, from dead fluotubes to Astra Militarum empty Autocannon cases and daily casualty on the battlefield. She even records the number of downloads of her STL template.
As part of her missions, she frequently goes on field trips to accompany Regimental HQ staff (where she carries a sidearm for self defence).

It is on one of such missions that she met with Inquisitor Johevian of the Ordo Aegis. Now she works for him undercover and has even been sighted with him as part of his retinue.

As always, "Watch" if you want to be informed of any updates.

Digitally kitbashed together some human auxillary helmets for my army, thought it'd be good to share around. I've included 12 variants, but you could make a lot more using the parts available, so I've included a Blender file for people who want to make their own.

The heads are a little on the large side (I think they're in scale, guardsmen heads are just huge), I attached an example image of them which should give you an idea of size, depending on the body you end up using you might want to scale down a touch.

I've added a set of presupported heads, but I'm not super experienced with creating presupports so your mileage may vary. Printed perfectly for me but I have my settings pretty well dialed in and print with pretty conservative speeds.

These are based on Ziocru's Angry Spaceguards Hostile Environment Heads Set (https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/angry-spaceguards-hostile-environment-heads-set), which is itself a remix from a few different creators;

-DavikDesigns https://cults3d.com/en/users/davikdesigns
-Mard3r https://www.thingiverse.com/mard3r/designs
-Kharn3655 https://www.thingiverse.com/kharn3655/designs
-LoggyK https://cults3d.com/en/users/LoggyK
-MkHand_Industries https://cults3d.com/en/users/Mkhand_Industries
-Mrmcangry https://www.thingiverse.com/mrmcangry/designs
-Cornivius https://cults3d.com/en/users/Red-warden-miniatures

Feel free to remix and share as you like.

Hey friend, I would appreciate a lot if you'll check my Boosty first, it's like Patreon, but local. There are some... issues with Cults.
https://boosty.to/easyv

In the vast world of 40k exist a myriad of various marks, patterns and types of humble lasgun, and, as usual, GW had forgot about most of them. Fine, I'll do it myself. This compendium is mine attempt to render at least some of the canon models and some inspired by real life and media. But not only that - aside from prebuilt models every gun is separated to its base components - central part, barrel, grip, stock, sight and attachment. Because half of the fun comes from fine tuning the шмаляло for your needs.

WHAT'S INSIDE:
Codex patterns: Kantrael, Kantrael Short, Mk4, Voss, Mars, Galaxy, Ryza, Triplex, Lucius - both FW and GW, Accatran, Vostroyan and some unnamed;
Non-codex models: WolfTNO Sturmgewehr 46 and 60, G36, M16, Colt Commando, HK53 both with or without M203 (or you can call it MP5, difference in this scale is not that big), Japenese Type 11 LMG and Type 97 AT rifle (that's some big longlas), AK-74, both regular and short, uuuh, ОЦ-14 (that not transliterates good) (k fine OTs-14).

Pick your poison - https://linktr.ee/easyv

Plasma weapons are extremely effective at close to medium range. Together with kinetic damage, it transfers significant thermal damage to the target. At close range, this weapon has a chance to damage even heavy armored vehicles. During the Last War, plasma weapons were widespread among the Shapers.

Despite its high efficiency, this weapon has its drawbacks. The lethality of the weapon decreases significantly with distance. The design of this weapon is quite complex, which requires a high production culture and careful maintenance. And in case of malfunctions, self-detonation of the weapon is quite possible.

Jet weapons became widespread during the Last War. The ammunition of this weapon is accelerated by a jet stream. It has practically no recoil, and ammunition can hit a wide variety of targets. Cumulative and armor-piercing ammunition can easily cope with light enemy vehicles. Ammunition with programmable detonation will not leave any chance for the infantry, even in cover.

However, this weapon also has a number of disadvantages. It is quite heavy and for long-term use it is necessary to have exo-armor or genetic modifications. It is also extremely ineffective at close ranges, since the ammunition does not have time to pick up the required speed.

The weapon can be equipped with various magazines. To improve the accuracy of fire, it is possible to install an elongated barrel. Installation of an optical sight is also possible.

**These are proxy models for an existing game system and are not intended for use as permanent replacements for their legitimate game model counterparts.**

These holy ladies march into battle with shield and halberd, ready to purge heretics with bolter and blade.

There are **five** different poses, both with a helmeted and non-helmeted variant. There are also four backpacks, however, they are all identical with the exception of purity seals, so you may use any backpack with any Sister.

Now also included: Sisters 1-5 A pre-supported
Also included: Sisters 1-5B with maces, a remix of mine by another and lost to the void.

If you have any questions, shoot me an email!

Also, **For Printing:** Just rotate the model back (typically 45 degrees) and add auto-supports using light supports. I did mine at 50% density because I love supports, and I have had no print issues. One spot to look out for is the magazine on the bolt pistol, however. I found that it was not supported on Sacresant 1 during my test print and the bottom of the magazine was warped slightly.

Lastly, big thanks to:
 -Jimsbeanz who's armor designs were the base of the torsos and legs.
-Oldgez who released shield designs just in time to save me the trouble of making them myself.

Beltanya Zukhal is a legal clerc of the Administratum whose task is to record anything and everything, from dead fluotubes to Astra Militarum empty Autocannon cases and daily casualty on the battlefield. She even records the number of downloads of her STL template.
As part of her missions, she frequently goes on field trips to accompany Regimental HQ staff (where she carries a sidearm for self defence).

It is on one of such missions that she met with Inquisitor Johevian of the Ordo Aegis. Now she works for him undercover and has even been sighted with him as part of his retinue.

As always, "Watch" if you want to be informed of any updates.

I remixed this pieces from my [scap box](https://www.thingiverse.com/mangforge/collections/scrap-box):
 + [Laspistol](https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:3559689)
 + [Gothic dataslate](https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:4800103)

Hello and welcome to the scifi heavy weapons collection!

These aren't the most beautiful or elegant weapons, but they ought to go nicely with your existing plastic models for maximum destruction of enemies large and small.

These are remixed from... loads of stuff I had laying around, including stuff from LoggyK, Landon73, and SebTheis. If I used a bit of yours and your name's not on that list, sorry! Please let me know!

**Printing Notes!** I haven't tested these extensively, and I only printed them in resin, so I have no idea what problems might exist. Please let me know if there are problems, and I can try to fix them for a future version.

This is a reupload as the original wasn't showing up under my designs, and I also wanted to add another version, with the sword in a resting position and a bionic arm.

"He looked over the horizon, he'd grown accustomed to the ash wastes of Teidon Prime, just like he had with the endless swamps of Delta-64-91. He'd been on countless worlds, each a different home, with different families. Families he'd soon depart with, as he once again would be the only one out of the warzone. He gave a fake smile to the corporal next to him, who smiled back unknowingly that the sergeant had done the same to last 3 men and women assigned to him. "another warzone corporal, another battle to win. Remember your training, and I'll make sure you'll be back home with your family in a couple of months". He donned his mask and yelled orders for the charge, already having said goodbye to those around him"

This is a single model, meant to represent either a veteran sergeant or higher ranking officer of the Hostile Environment Guardsmen.
He's armed with a powered sword, plasma pistol and improved armour against shrapnell.

Remixed from the following parts:
Heroic scale heads for wargaming miniatures 28mm. By Brexit: https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:3217411

Big props to the originators of the files i remixed from!

These are conversion parts for turning regular Intercessors into Suppressors.

I like the idea of what Suppressors can do but not how the official models look, super unwieldy guns, grav/jump packs not looking jump-packy enough, odd moon boots.
(and those models are only available in a boxed set that also containing lots of stuff im not interested in) .

After looking at some conversions and kitbashes i decided to try doing a remix that would be more to my taste, this is what i came up with.

To use this one needs to cut away the Bolt Rifle from the right hand and scoop material out of the left hand to fit the handle (or replace said hand with an empty bolter left from a previous marine kit).

Ive used Dark Imperium Intercessors for mine but these parts should be usable on pretty much any of the Intercessor models holding their bolter with both hands.

Suppressors go on 40mm bases, here is one: https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:3312581

She hates heretics, she hates xenos, she hates demons, she hates traitors, and she's super pissed.

It should print well on resin printers at 28mm scale.

Check our Patreon : The Makers Cult
https://www.patreon.com/themakerscult

In the grimdark future, there is no peace between the stars and thus the gargantuan warmachine of the empire can never be allowed to cease its bloody grind for even a moment. To ensure the continued readiness of the millions of tanks, aircraft and artillery pieces of Mankind, these augmented priests wade through hails of gunfire and plasma to apply sacred unguents and binaric rites wherever a machine in the arsenal of Mankind has been crippled. It is their duty to spark their engines back to life and rouse their spirits to join the fray once more, ready to bring death to the enemy and glory to the god of machines.

I might add some trophies or other personalized elements (purity seals, augmentations, decapitated heads of alien filth ... you know, the usual).
EDIT: Aaaaand, there we go. Also cleaned it up a bit and rescaled it.

Countless men and women fight and die across the galaxy each passing day to stem the neverending tide of traitors, mutants and aliens that threaten the forges of their Cult. Occasionally a loyal son of Mars, that fell in battle against the enemies of Man, can be granted a second chance to serve the Quest for Knowledge. Through arcane and ancient procedures he will be reforged into more machine than man, the posthuman peak of the cybernetic arts and perhaps one of the most terrifying shock troopers in the arsenal of mankind. Shrouded in an aura of static white noise, that overloads mechanical receptors and sensory organs alike, they quickly and mercilessly descend upon their disoriented and defenseless prey and disappear again, before their enemies can fully comprehend the slaughter that just transpired.

I have not printed this one yet, so I can't guarantee that the limbs will fit the body perfectly. If you want to give it a go, I would be happy to hear how it turned out.

Broke out the sword from the amazing Bloody Glorious Hawk Boy model to use as a spiritual weapon for a DND Cleric character and got a lot of requests to post the STL. Recommend printing on a resin printer. If you have a really well dialed in FDM printer you can try printing the file as it's imported with supports to have the best chance of getting the flames to come out. Might not be a bad idea to scale up to 110 or 120% for FDM to give the fine details a better chance.

Once printed simply glue it to your favorite base model which can easily be printed in FDM or resin. Here's one of my favorite packs:

Even within the dogmatic and zealous organisation, that is the Cult of Machines, few can hope to match the fanatism of these monks, who are going so far as to invite the frightening might of the kinetic force into their very own bodies until their skin cracks and their eyes boil in their sockets under the electrical inferno. But the rewards for the faithful far outweigh such petty losses as sight and sense of touch, as they are able to stride into the apocalyptic battlefields of the future almost naked, untouchable by deadly projectiles and shrapnels, for the kinetic force shields their own from the attacks of the unenlightened in a shroud of lightning. And in turn each strike of the arcane weapons of these pilgrims leaves enemies and heretical warmachines alike lying cold and dead, as their bioelectricity is absorbed from their unworthy bodies.

I always felt a certain affection to this model series, since they were some of my very first models. Now, with six good ones, which carry enough bits to remix a squad of twenty if necessary, I feel like a can put them aside for the time being Hope you are as content with them as I am.

These STL files are designed to equip my [Sculptris Dummies](https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:1972042). You won't be able to import these files into Sculptris, though once you get your character posed, you can align these parts in any model staging platform (MakerBot Deskto, Blender, Meshmixer, or 3D Builder are all good choices). All of these parts are also available in Andrew Stockton's awesome [Desktop Hero](https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/263291121/desktophero-free-3d-printable-character-maker) project as well (which is quite a bit easier than adjusting all the parts by hand). All of these weapons have been scaled to 28mm/Heroic scale, so they should be ready for any kind of miniature conversion if you want to print them separately.

If you make anything with these (including through Desktop Hero), let me know and post a link here in the comments section (and certainly post a remix when you have something printable). I'd love to see what you come up with!

You can find an expanding collection of compatible parts [here](https://www.thingiverse.com/dutchmogul/collections/desktop-hero-parts).

We've set up a [Patreon page](https://www.patreon.com/illgottengames) for anyone who's interested in helping to fund us so we can keep making free and open sourced games like Pocket-Tactics, Wayfarer Tactics. and others, not to mention the growing catalog of gaming miniatures that you can use for whatever you want! (Psst... we take requests and commissions...)

Enjoy!
